outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (composite of spontaneous abortion, IUFD, preterm birth, maternal death)
Adverse birth outcomes (composite of intrapartum fetal demise, low birth weight, neonatal death)
cohort: The study included 2490 HIV-infected pregnant women enrolled in routine prevention of mother-to-child transmission (PMTCT) care across fourteen hospitals in Ethiopia.
finding: Dolutegravir (DTG)-based antiretroviral regimens were associated with a 43% lower risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes and a 53% lower risk of preterm birth compared to Efavirenz (EFV)-based regimens.
